title: Why "Savings" Claims Can Be A Scam...and How to Double Check The Math...
subtitle: Absent Independent validation of claims related to savings, it can be hard to know!
body_html:
I love statistics. And math. Not, it should be pointed out, because I’m good at them. NO, heavens, no. I was a bad math student.

I think they can reveal fascinating truths! And catch scammers. I enjoy busting on scammers— almost as much as I enjoy not being scammed in the first place. Claims around savings, and particularly “shared savings,” are my white wale in employee benefits.

Here a quick explainer!
